name: Coastal Oak 6mm LVP
description: 100% waterproof luxury vinyl plank with realistic wood grain texture. Attached underlayment included. Click-lock installation — no glue required. Perfect for kitchens, bathrooms, and basements.
notes: Covers approx. 20 sq ft per box. Order 10% extra for cuts and waste.

name: Driftwood Gray 8mm LVP
description: Contemporary cool-gray tone with subtle wood texture. Extra thick 8mm core for added sound absorption. 20mil commercial-grade wear layer resists scratches from pets and high-heel shoes.
notes: Ideal for rental properties and high-traffic areas. Backed by lifetime residential warranty.

name: Natural Hickory 12mm LVP
description: Premium thick-plank LVP with dramatic hickory grain variation. Rigid core construction handles minor subfloor imperfections without transition strips in most rooms.
notes: Longer plank format (72") creates a more premium look. Great for open-plan spaces.

name: Whitewash Pine Wide Plank LVP
description: Farmhouse-inspired whitewashed finish with wide 9" planks. Fully waterproof, pet-proof, and kid-proof. The 12mil wear layer handles everyday wear in busy homes.
notes: Wide plank formats look best in larger rooms. Ask us about sample before ordering.
